body:
Adding three items to this bundle, surfaced by the desk-migration intake (2026-07-14):

1. **Governance-map routing is stale post-migration (PR #110):** `docs/governance-map.md` routes strategy readouts to "cowork" — the retired old desk. The strategy desk is now `dev-tooling-desk` (executive desk, local). Update the routing text (lines ~38 and the Strategy Desk section ~50), and clarify that in-repo `_meta/briefings/` holds repo-local briefings only.
2. **Pre-existing dangler:** `docs/decisions/0006-meta-tracked-by-default.md:16` cites `_meta/plans/meta-gitignore-policy/plan.md`, which was archived to `_meta/_archive/99-meta-gitignore-policy.md`.
3. **Cross-repo dangler (workbench):** `dotfiles-agents-workbench/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/{bug,feature}.yml` tell authors to consult `_meta/plans/_config.md`, which doesn't exist in that repo (its plans desk carries no local `_utils/`/config and defers to this repo's).

https://claude.ai/code/session_01TUHL7TdyWLxjSCXGKY8m89

**Executive-desk re-triage ruling (Henry, 2026-07-16; enacting decision 0016 §6 "keep only what a use case still pulls"; recorded as desk decision 0017).**

**Closed — mooted by the clean-room swap.** The docs this bundle patches do not survive the rebuild (#111); fresh docs are authored there. Anything that resurfaces post-rebuild gets filed fresh against the new docs. The item list stays readable here and in the desk's migrated planning archive.
